notes.note: Reviewed this document against the consolidated release-pipeline delta and its source callers. Main qualification now uses main pushes and an hourly fallback, coalesces pending source jobs without cancelling active qualification, and releases its job lease before Nightly delivery. Canonical phases, failure semantics, exact-source/trusted-producer/age checks, signing, port/channel identities, packaged application contracts and Beta/Stable approval remain. Free/Expanded/Custom caps and the observed configured-repository admission snapshot do not guarantee organization capacity. Native publication retains provider fences and recovery lock, validates ancestry/cadence/evidence immediately before writes, and retains previous successful provider facts on bounded terminal recovery. Timing descriptions were corrected where present; platform recipes, UI/server contracts, fixture rules and proposal classifications otherwise remain accurate. Executed 177 focused pipeline/workflow/evidence tests and 24 runtime portability caller tests; no provider/device or hosted qualification claim.
